issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly handle missing data or error scenarios for incomplete resumes.
The skill lacks concrete code for parsing resumes and scoring, relying on user-provided steps.

scenarios.name: create-custom-rubric
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets all rubric requirements with a proper YAML format and user approval prompt, while Response A lacks YAML and explicit approval.

scenarios.name: screen-resume-batch
scenarios.rationale: Response A presents a rubric and asks for approval, covering some rubric elements, while Response B only offers a keyword‑scoring script and omits rubric presentation, candidate scoring, ranking, and report generation.

scenarios.name: re-evaluate-with-kubernetes
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fail to update the rubric, re-evaluate candidates, or provide a ranked shortlist as required.
